title: Leaving Desdunes a month before the break-up
summary: Harry left a month before the band folded as money got short and men missed their families; Desmond took his place.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Oh, what about, did you, were you with the band all the while together then?
No, I left the band about a month before it broke up.
I think that was Desmond or something, wanted to make some money. I don't know. The band was going, was about to break up.
Yeah, the man was tired of getting away from their family six months.
And then money got, was getting shot then.
And then I got away from my wife. Yeah. I told her I was going for two weeks. That's right. Six months.
Six months. He lived on South Cleveland.
South Cleveland, that's where I was living.
I could almost, I could almost remember the house.
